content:
maria_procure: Heads-up — Nexa issued a credit note for 12 GPUs on PO #INV-4789 but we only shipped 10 RMA serials back. Need reconciliation before finance posts the credit. AWB: 1Z999AA10123456784

alex_logistics: checking AWB and depot scan logs now. saw 10 items scanned out from DC2 on 2026-02-18 09:12. Can you paste the vendor credit PDF?

nexasupply_bot: Vendor claim: "Credit issued: 12 units; reason: DOA batch". Reference: NS-CR-2026-0312

lina_sre: important to confirm serials — we had 2 preflight rejects that never entered depot. Those might be counted by vendor. @alex_logistics can you run a serial reconcile between our inbound scans and their RMA manifest?

alex_logistics: running query now. partial output:
```
scanned_serials: [SN-A1001, SN-A1002, SN-A1003, SN-A1004, SN-A1005, SN-A1006, SN-A1007, SN-A1008, SN-A1009, SN-A1010]
vendor_manifest: [SN-A1001, SN-A1002, SN-A1003, SN-A1004, SN-A1005, SN-A1006, SN-A1007, SN-A1008, SN-A1009, SN-A1010, SN-A1011, SN-A1012]
```
So two extra serials on their manifest (SN-A1011, SN-A1012) not in our intake.

raj_ops: did we ever generate temporary serials or hold IDs? I remember a staging swap last month.

maria_procure: there were 2 temporary IDs created for loaners that never shipped: TMP-LOAN-21, TMP-LOAN-22. Vendor might have mapped them to real SKUs when issuing credit.

sophie_finance: finance can't apply the credit until serials match or vendor issues an adjusted CN. Is vendor willing to void the two extra unit credits and reissue for 10? @maria_procure

maria_procure: I emailed vendor asking for either (a) proof of physical receipt for the extra two, or (b) an adjusted credit for 10 units + note to void 2 units. Sent at 2026-02-18 10:05. CC: @sophie_finance

nexasupply_bot: Vendor response received: "Investigating scanning discrepancy. We will confirm within 48 hours and either reissue or provide proof of receipt." Ref NS-TKT-8873

alex_logistics: also flagged customs paperwork: the AWB shows 12 units and customs cleared 12. If vendor returns proof of customs handover we may need to open a depot investigation — could be customs mis-declare. @lina_sre

lina_sre: if customs doc lists 12 but depot scanned 10, likely two were diverted (DOA to vendor depot) or lost in transit. We'll escalate with depot ops. Please capture chain-of-custody docs.

maria_procure: noted. I'll collect vendor.pdf, AWB scan, inbound DC scan, and the temporary loaner logs. Next steps: grant finance a hold on the credit until reconciliation completes. ETA: vendor reply within 48h, depot investigation 72h.

sophie_finance: hold placed. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

alex_logistics: logging a follow-up ticket for depot ops: DEPOT-4521. I'll update here once the scan audit finishes.

maria_procure: thanks — I'll push for expedited confirmation since we need to reconcile monthly close. :pray:
